title: Rationale for Support Threshold in Jobs Growth Incentive Scheme
what_it_is: Rationale for Support Threshold in Jobs Growth Incentive Scheme

sections.label: Jobs Growth Incentive support threshold
sections.summary: MP asks how the 50% support threshold for mature local hires is derived and whether it will rise to 75%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower with regard to the Jobs Growth Incentive scheme (a) how does the Ministry derive the support threshold of 50% for mature local hires aged 40 and above; and (b) whether the Ministry will consider increasing this support threshold to 75% to incentivise more employers to hire mature local workers instead of foreign workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package was launched in April 2020 with the goal of curating 100,000 jobs and skills opportunities for Singaporean workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: From April to October, the National Jobs Council or NJC, working in partnership with employers and unions, placed nearly 60,000 jobseekers into various opportunities.

sections.label: Government underwriting mature worker salaries
sections.summary: The Government will underwrite 50% of salaries, up to the first $5,000, for 12 months to encourage hiring mature jobseekers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: To encourage employers to consider hiring more mature jobseekers, the Government will underwrite 50% of their salaries, up to the first $5,000, for 12 months.

sections.label: Aviation and tourism support measures
sections.summary: MOT introduced the Enhanced Aviation Support Package, and STB launched a domestic tourism campaign and SingapoRediscovers Vouchers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: For the aviation sector, MOT introduced the Enhanced Aviation Support Package to preserve core capabilities and to support our local carriers to regain air connectivity to the world.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: STB also launched a domestic tourism campaign and the SingapoRediscovers Vouchers to drive local tourism and stimulate sectoral activity.

sections.label: Jobs Growth Incentive and older unemployment
sections.summary: The JGI lets well-performing firms bring forward hiring, and MOM's report showed higher unemployment among residents aged 40 to 59.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The Jobs Growth Incentive will enable firms that continue to do well in the current climate to bring forward their hiring plans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: According to MOM's Third Quarter Labour Market Report, unemployment rate among residents aged between 40 and 59 was higher and rose more steeply compared to all other age groups except those below 30, so I am hopeful that the JGI will help this group.

sections.label: Employment returning to pre-COVID levels
sections.summary: By the end of the third quarter, Singapore's employment levels had returned almost to pre-COVID-19 levels.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In the case of Singapore, what we have found is that by the end of the third quarter, the employment levels have returned almost to pre-COVID-19 levels.

sections.label: JGI budget and take-up review
sections.summary: The Government set aside $1 billion for the JGI and will review take-up and adjust if necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The Government has set aside a budget of $1 billion for the JGI and we will look at the take-up rate and make adjustments if it is necessary to do so, as we have done for all schemes in the past.

sections.label: Government aim on employment
sections.summary: The Government's aim is to try to expand employment and bring down unemployment.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Overall, as a Government, our aim must be to try and expand employment and bring down unemployment.

sections.label: Holistic approach to boost employment
sections.summary: A more holistic approach is needed to boost employment and bring down unemployment, with commitment and effort, and other interventions considered if needed.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: It is a more holistic approach that we have to employ in order to ensure that we are able to boost employment and bring down unemployment.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: But the commitment is certainly there and we are putting all the effort that can be conceived of, and if there are other interventions that are needed, we will certainly also consider the need and the timeliness to do so.

sections.label: Risk of no future employment
sections.summary: People unable to get meaningful positions risk never having standard employment in future.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If people, for some reason, are not able to get into a meaningful position, whether it is company hosted traineeships or attachments or whether it is training programmes that are course based, I think the risk to them is not so much that they do not have standard employment now; the risk to them is that they will never have standard employment in future.
